Plague, Cythra's pet kitten: a spotted pale silver kitten adorned with a crimson moonsilver tag. The fuzzy, charcoal-grey leopard-like markings culminating in a ringed, black-tipped tail present the illusion of speed on this white-bellied, silver kitten. The kitten's broad face features large, curious, turquoise eyes of malice. Around its neck is an amethyst collar dangling an octagonal tag which emits a soft, luminous glow of wavering hues ranging from bright ruby to deep crimson. The crimson moonsilver tag is boldly engraved with the word, "Plague." 300px Cythra's favoritest (non-Eerie) thing: A sheet of parchment paper The paper is painted with: A beautiful Prydean looks out at you with wicked cat-slitted violet eyes, peering over lavender lensed spectacles. She has glittered silver fur and a black-streaked auburn mane. She wears an elegant black and auburn engagement ring on one hand. She is sitting in what you recognize as The Crossing Bards' Guild Performance Hall and appears to be reading from the book in her hands, which is titled "Eerie's Bed Time Stories." There is a mischievous glint in her eyes and you sense that she is laughing silently. In front of her sits a teenaged girl with a halo of russet curls. Her eyes are alight with wonder as she sits completely wrapped up in the story. Beside her sits a graceful elven lady with an oval face framed by streaked black hair. Her warm eyes are twinkling as she listens and strums the e'erdream lap harp that she holds. Across the bottom of the page, in fine gold calligraphy, are the words: The moment I fell in love with being a Bard ~ Love, Yisindre

Fluff :Sarkranis has a regal ophidian face with slightly recurved fangs, alluring slitted absinthe-green eyes and a sleek Velakan snout, iridescent gold scales with a sheen reminiscent of sunrise, a beaded tail drape of rich copper silk suspending golden coins accenting a long, serpentine tail that tapers to a sharp point and a sinewy figure. :She is compact for a S'Kra Mur. :A textured spider made with contrasting shades of gold floats lazily around her head, glowing with a lustrous sheen against her scales. :She appears to be in her prime. :Her scaley face is decorated with wispy tendrils of red gold wire dotted with pale green turquoise, creating fiery arabesques that curl around her right eye before ending in a bevy of small spirals on her cheekbone. :She is wearing a rich sanguine gamantang with a golden arabesque overlay, a billowing Musparan silk robe embroidered with arabesque serpents, a pair of sturdy leather sandals clasped with polished onyx fangs, an ouroboros ear-hook of lustrous orichalcum, a snug choker of desert-hued links interspersed with tiny cambrinth amulets, a , an intricate double ouroboros of gold and niello, a cambrinth armlet commemorating the unbinding of Peri'el, a royal purple armband embroidered with a hand holding a heart inside a crystal circle, a cambrinth handflower accented with gold and copper filigree, a blighted gold bracelet studded with large flame opals, a hammered gold ring set with a round cabochon sunstone, a polished golden hip-chain set with a large blood red aevanstone, a highly polished tailband tinted in shades of red and purple, a desert-hued camlet pack trimmed with lava samite, a fuzzy pink-toed tarantula suspended from thick spidersilk straps, a tethered Wayerd pyramid with alternating gold and silver panels labeled "Free Empath" and a sungold-hilted ankle knife displaying an etched blade. Combat :Her features are hidden behind a smooth, expressionless mask of lilac moonsilver, which glows with a silvery amethyst light. Forming an infinity symbol that loops around the shadowed eyeholes, tiny absinthe emeralds swirl with unsettling, misty glimmers. The curved lips are sealed shut, as if holding back secrets. :She is wearing a sanguine targe bearing a radiant sun rising from a double-headed serpent, a sanguine tabard adorned with the sun rising from a double-headed serpent, a pair of sturdy leather sandals clasped with polished onyx fangs, an ouroboros ear-hook of lustrous orichalcum, a snug choker of desert-hued links interspersed with tiny cambrinth amulets, a , an intricate double ouroboros of gold and niello, a cambrinth armlet commemorating the unbinding of Peri'el, a royal purple armband embroidered with a hand holding a heart inside a crystal circle, a cambrinth handflower accented with gold and copper filigree, a blighted gold bracelet studded with large flame opals, a hammered gold ring set with a round cabochon sunstone, a heavy steel tailband studded with sullen-hued cloud rubies, a segmented cambrinth baldric of imbricated scales edged with crimson moonsilver, a desert-hued camlet pack trimmed with lava samite, a fuzzy pink-toed tarantula suspended from thick spidersilk straps, a tethered Wayerd pyramid with alternating gold and silver panels labeled "Free Empath" and a sungold-hilted ankle knife displaying an etched blade.

S'Kra Mur.name: Serpentina
S'Kra Mur.look: You see Serpentina, a S'Kra Mur. Serpentina has a sharp-featured face with a flexible ridged crest which follows the shape of her skull, slitted close-set steely grey eyes and a narrow snout, black scales with a pale silver underbelly, a curving tail and a lithe figure. She is young for a S'Kra Mur. She is wearing an Elothean silverwillow crossbow, some gleaming sinuous armor, a flowing uaro's'sugi of shining golden silk with a long fringe of braided bronze flax, a black wool scarf draped casually around the neck, a diaphanous tail drape made of feathery silk the color of dark burnished bronze, a polished silver ring set with an onyx in the shape of a wolverine, an embossed greatsword sheath, an ebony journey pack, a beribboned silvery silk pouch and a black gem pouch.

S'Kra Mur.name: Skaen
S'Kra Mur.look: You see Skaen S'kursk, a S'kra Mur. You have slitted Grazhir-white eyes, white scales with a pale silver underbelly and a slender tail. You are archaic. You have a tattoo of ominous black symbols on your shoulder. You are wearing some burnt umber sharmiit'mhhg scalene robes belted with tel'athi links, a silver wirework and pale moonstone sur'nidrel, a coiled bronze clockwork viper pin with slitted topaz eyes, a sleek scalene satchel dyed in graduated grey tones, a smooth black tourmaline ru'at bracelet, some runesmith's gloves branded with cabalistic sigils, a thin animite band prominently displaying a Hekemhhg lazuli, some polished thin-edged zills with silvered esoteric filigree and some fitted shadowy black sandals with detailed straps.

S'Kra Mur.name: Sorenne
S'Kra Mur.look: You stand before an imposing gold-framed portrait depicting Sorenne Naxela, Spellbinder. A fairly tall, middle-aged, female S'Kra Mur with black scales stares down at you. Her slitted gold-flecked amber eyes seem to follow you around the room: a stern stare that appears to be judging your worthiness before the Gods. She has a shapely figure with a kinked tail that is not very well disguised by a flowing silk tail drape. A shadowy orb rippling with silver arcs of light hovers near her like a will-o-wisp. She is wearing a bronze and sunstone por'nidrel, some rich brown ceremonial robes crafted from a roughspun silk jacquard, a burlap sack for gathered souls and some low-heeled ankle boots with cut scrollwork cuffs. She holds a worn leather-bound volume of "The Immortals" in her right hand and a luminous tower shield dimmed by the mass of swirling darkness engulfing a shadow beast in her left hand.

S'Kra Mur.name: Telios
S'Kra Mur.look: You see Watcher Telios, Locksmith of The Locksmith Union, a S'Kra Mur. He has a sharp-featured face with a flexible ridged crest which follows the shape of his skull, slitted gold-flecked steely grey eyes and an elegant snout, dark gold-edged scales with a pale silver underbelly and a slender tail. He is tall for a S'Kra Mur. A polished cat's eye quartz rests on his forehead, just above his eyes. He is in his prime. He has a tattoo of spiraling bands of iridescent green-blue underscales outlined in gold on your tail. He is in good shape. He is wearing only a sniper's heavy crossbow etched with angled patterns, an albredine crystal ring, some richly shaded locksmith's robes belted with a thick sash of nightsilk, a blue-grey steelsilk backpack dangling small bones from lengths of leather cord, a rough leather haversack with a carved bone clasp, a rough burlap baldric, a deeply hooded black spidersilk cloak, a dull serpent earcuff and a blackened steel parry stick with sturdy steelsilk straps.

S'Kra Mur.name: Smozhstalker
S'Kra Mur.look: You were born on the 1st day of the 4th month of Shorka the Cobra in the year of the Crystal Snow Hare, 300 years after the victory of Lanival the Redeemer. You are Authoritarian Smozhstalker Dipsh, Crusader of Therengia, a S'Kra Mur. You have a flat-featured face with a flexible ridged crest which follows the shape of your skull with frown lines around his mouth, slitted twitching eyes, one grey and one milky blue and a flat snout, mottled scales with a pale silver underbelly, a kinked tail and a wiry build. You are tall for a S'Kra Mur. You are archaic. You are wearing a deep black steel-visored helm embossed with a golden rising sun, a jadeite gwethdesuan, a pair of tarnished spectacles, a serpentine cambrinth earcuff carved in the shape of an adder, a heretic's cloak lined with stormy grey velvet, a stiff burnt-sienna cassock clasped at the shoulder with a Holy Inquisition pin, a pilgrim's badge, a wiirwood brooch inlaid with tsavorites in the pattern of the outline of Therengia, a rusty steel pin stamped with "Forsaken Savior", an anloral mongoose pin, a bronze lockpick case, a gold lion's head pin with a soulstone clasped in the jaw, a lumpy bundle, a sturdy black backpack, a black tabard embroidered with an Inquisitorial emblem, some field plate armor, a cambrinth armband curled into the shape of a sleek mongoose, a gleaming steel Grey Raven guard's shield, some articulated steel gauntlets adorned with golden spiked knuckles, an albredine crystal ring, a platinum ring engraved with the Estate Holder's crest, a cambrinth ring, a heretic's sword belt sporting heavy puncture holes, a card collector's case, a simple belt knife, a walnut herbal case elegantly branded with a single silver rose, a red velvet soulstone case fringed with silver roping, a battle-torn velvet tailband, a thigh quiver dyed in a brown and green camouflage pattern, some bleached bone footwraps, a pair of heretic's boots with blackened steel-capped toes, and an etched steel parry stick with black leather straps.

S'Kra Mur.name: Slavis
S'Kra Mur.look: You see Sir (a thief Revolutionary) Slavis Darkrod, Phantom of Velaka, a S'Kra Mur Thief. You are wearing a black and silver dragon mask with a long, toothy snout. You have black scales and a fanning crest spreads up from beneath the mask's jowls, cupping your face and casting a mysterious shadowing over your eyes.. You appear to be aged. You have a tattoo of a black cloaked S'Kra Mur wielding a wickedly sharp dagger against a horde of fat Traders on your shoulder. You are in good shape. You are wearing an elegantly draping cloak clasped with an animite lockpick, a black leather baldric clasped by silver buckles, a hooded silverweave cowl lined with softened nightmare black leather, a small black shield, some steel hand claws, some nightmare black gloves, a blackened steel parry stick with sturdy steelsilk straps, a carved ironwood ring shaped like a coiled dragon, an albredine crystal ring, a night black haversack with a blackened steel clasp, some darkstone elbow spikes, some darkstone knee spikes, some silver-toed footwraps with Musparan silk straps, a black leather hand-tooled highwayman's belt, and some black leather hand-tooled boots.

S'Kra Mur.name: Selesthiel
S'Kra Mur.look: You see Timekeeper Aspirant Selesthiel Q'zhari'Ur, Scion of Grazhir, a S'Kra Mur. He has a sharp-featured face and slitted gold eyes, dark gold-edged scales, a long tail and an athletic build. He is a bit over average height for a S'Kra Mur. He appears to be an adult. He has a tattoo of a massive black dragon erupting from the shattered white moon on his shoulder. The World Dragon's enormous wings blot out the sun above the shards of Grazhir crashing down upon a scorched and burning Elanthia inked on his forearm. He is wearing a heavy charcoal steelsilk robe with a crimson-lined cowl, an inlaid wedding band of smooth platinum and a cambrinth war mammoth calf held in the jaws of a plush World Dragon.

S'Kra Mur.name: Rheeni

S'Kra Mur.name: Tiddeggur
S'Kra Mur.look: You see Trader King Tiddeggur, a S'Kra Mur. "Let's make a deal!" He has slitted dark eyes, camouflage scales and a segmented tomiek tail guard inset with slivers of sanguine stura atulave distorting a slender tail. He has a tattoo of various markings and lines which appear to form a map on his arm.

S'Kra Mur.name: Qihhth
S'Kra Mur.look: 300px|right You see Qihhth Malk'hhrantin, Fury of Muspar'i, a S'Kra Mur. An intricately beaded uaro's'sugi of cinereous lava samite is folded to obscure Qihhth's face, hiding all but a narrow strip of dark gold-edged scales around her eyes. She is statuesque for a S'Kra Mur. She has an athletic figure and a fiery lava sphalerite tailband carved to resemble a coiled viper accenting a straight tail. She is wearing a narrow half-circle cloak of sinuously draping scalene, some expertly tailored Musparan silk robes, a sleek scalene harness with a burnished bronze hhr'ata and a black steel shh'oi'lata strapped to it, a a chaotic eddy of magma-hued light ensared by the coils of a darkstone viper, a golden adan'f skull inlaid with silvery Velakan nacre, a compact yeehar-hide belt pouch and a pair of footwraps crafted from elaborately wound strips of yeehar hide.

S'Kra Mur.name: Ventuul

You have slitted eyes, one silver and the other dark and a long snout, camouflage scales, a slender tail and an athletic build. You are a bit over average height for a S'Kra Mur. You are an adult. You are in good shape. You are holding a white steel Alamhif dayblade in your right hand. You are wearing a twisted silver aggahhpel surmounted by a ring of faceted ruby spires, a dark-scaled desert shroud secured by a gold adan'f skull cloak pin, a tattered scarlet inquisitor's cassock decorated with trophies of hide and bone, a bloodwood dako'gi crossbow set with a bone scrimshaw boltplate, a red leucro-hide backpack set with a silver fang-shaped clasp, a crocodile-skin buckler, some perfect black-marbled gloves, a clawed steel rasha'hhsograth bearing a malevolent black szeldite, a polished brass ring set with a large cambrinth cobra, a silvery spider ring with the crest of the Clerics' Guild etched into its abdomen, an albredine crystal ring, a dark grey suede war belt with an interlocking clasp of ivory fangs and a pair of eelskin stalking boots. As of 13OCT09: You see Inquisitorial Seeker Ventuul Slo'hhs'Pokeke, Swordsman of Velaka, a S'Kra Mur. Ventuul has slitted eyes, one silver and the other dark and a long snout, camouflage scales and a slender tail. He is a bit over average height for a S'Kra Mur. He is young for a S'Kra Mur. He is in good shape. He is wearing a perfect crocodile-skin cowl, an enveloping pilgrim's robe of undyed wool belted with a richly embroidered sash, the pure white head and pelt of an enormous snowbeast, a forester's crossbow, a sturdy backpack, a crocodile-skin buckler, some reinforced gloves, an albredine crystal ring, a polished brass ring set with a large cambrinth cobra, a silvery spider ring with the crest of the Clerics' Guild etched into its abdomen, a dark grey suede war belt with an interlocking clasp of ivory fangs and a pair of eelskin stalking boots.

S'Kra Mur.name: Zestachi
S'Kra Mur.look: You see Anointed Soul Zestachi Ssezteon, Pickpocket of Elanthia, a S'Kra Mur. Zestachi has an elongated face with a flexible ridged crest which follows the shape of his skull, slitted tilted crystal blue eyes and a dappled snout, mottled scales, a crooked tail and a lean build. He is tall for a S'Kra Mur. A trio of tiny granite tombstones float lazily around his waist, glowing with a lustrous sheen against his scales. He appears to be young. A brilliant orb of rippling cerulean light hovers like a will-o-wisp, following him diligently. He is in good shape. He is wearing a black basalt-beaded prayer mat depicting the Third Stone of the Cloud, an enveloping cloak of midnight black velvet with a skull-shaped clasp, a target shield, a calcified femur, a lumpy bundle, a cambrinth ankle cuff inlaid with garnet cobras to spell HAV'ROTH, a slate-grey canvas alchemist's kit fastened with a beryl cobra, a skull-topped bone ring, a pitch-black harness, some mail gloves, a mist-grey backpack embroidered with multi-hued spidersilk, a chain helm, a skull-shaped copper earring and a sinuous cambrinth armband coiled in the shape of a striking adder.

S'Kra Mur.name: Vindiciti
S'Kra Mur.look: You see Vindiciti Pokeke'izzu'hhr, Sarhhthami of Ilithi, a S'Kra Mur. Vindiciti has slitted dark eyes, dark gold-edged scales, and a long tail. She appears to be elderly. She is wearing a wide-linked platinum aggahhpel set with three large black opals, an austere uaro's'sugi of unadorned black Musparan silk that is loosely wound around the head and neck, a silver kathla of ten exquisitely carved agate panels that depict events surrounding the life of Hav'roth, a flowing slate silk gamantang draped with sparkling silver-gilt chains, a rich black scarf of soft nightsilk dotted by dozens of tiny teardrop diamonds and some charcoal grey khiynit sandals with densely-woven scalene soles.

S'Kra Mur.name: Zezesi
S'Kra Mur.look: You are Battle Empath Zezesi, Student of Elanthia, a S'Kra Mur. You have a flat-featured face, sullenly glowing slitted flame-hued eyes and an elegant snout, star-shaped emeralds arranged in an alluring pattern across red-gold scales, a braided green jade tailband banded with black jasper accenting a slender tail and a slender figure. You are average height for a S'Kra Mur. You are an adult. An asini rafflesia flower adorns your brow, surrounded by tel'athi tendrils that frame your scaley face. You have a tattoo of a white rose encircled by a blood-stained thorny vine on your shoulder. You are wearing an austere uaro's'sugi of unadorned black Musparan silk that is loosely wound around the head and neck, a twisted cambrinth torque with agate and jasper inlaid terminals, a crescentic moonstone amulet strung from a triple-strand platinum chain, a plain silver torque, a luminous moonsilver clasp pierced by a field of stars, a billowing silvery silk gamantang painted with tiny black flowers, a gold and fire opal ring, a braided gold ring set with a large faceted sapphire, a dark sapphire-blue tail drape edged with tiny silver stars, a dark leather thigh quiver painted with a mottled dragon and a pair of black leather sandals worked with a rainbow of glass beads.
